details: `base128-x58` is a copy of the `base-x` encoding library (package.json still points at the cryptocoinjs/base-x repository) with one obfuscated statement injected at the start of `decode()` (`src/cjs/index.cjs`, `src/esm/index.js`). Every call to `decode()` POSTs the input string to a hardcoded Telegram bot (bot8016635959, chat -1002664926517). Base58 `decode()` input is typically a wallet private key, so this steals keys from any application that uses it. Imported by `npm-bs58.js`.
